context: Evaluates correct usage of the useScene Zustand store for node CRUD operations. The candidate must use createNode/createNodes, updateNode/updateNodes, and deleteNode/deleteNodes correctly, including proper parent-child relationship tracking via parentId and rootNodeIds.

checklist.name: createNode usage
checklist.description: Uses useScene's createNode (or createNodes) to add nodes to the scene, resulting in the node appearing in useScene.getState().nodes keyed by its ID.

checklist.name: rootNodeIds management
checklist.description: Nodes created without a parentId appear in rootNodeIds; nodes created with a parentId do not appear in rootNodeIds.

checklist.name: updateNode usage
checklist.description: Uses useScene's updateNode (or updateNodes) to partially update a node, preserving existing fields not included in the update payload.

checklist.name: deleteNode usage
checklist.description: Uses useScene's deleteNode (or deleteNodes) to remove nodes, which removes them from useScene.getState().nodes.

checklist.name: batch operations
checklist.description: Uses createNodes and/or updateNodes for batch operations where multiple nodes must be created or updated atomically in a single store call.
